title: doSearch catch swallows errors silently — search failure shows no feedback to user
detail: Line 83: .catch(function() { setSearching(false); }) — if fetchContractsPaginated fails, the catch clears the spinner but shows no error. The search panel reverts to 'Type a customer name...' as if nothing happened.
evidence: ViewSplitPanel.jsx:83 — catch block only sets searching to false.
recommendedFix: Add error state and render 'Search failed — please try again' message. Or import useToast and show a toast.

title: doSearch builds OData filter with inline single-quote escape — should use centralized escapeOdataString
detail: Line 77: val.replace(/'/g, "''") — correct OData escape but done inline rather than using the escapeOdataString helper from portalApi.js. Same concern as CR-2026-04-09-0217.
recommendedFix: Import and use escapeOdataString from portalApi.js.

title: Split panel search input has no label or aria-label
detail: Line 119: the search input has placeholder text but no aria-label, <label>, or aria-labelledby. Same gap as CR-2026-04-09-0700.
evidence: ViewSplitPanel.jsx:119 — input with placeholder but no aria-label.
recommendedFix: Add 'aria-label': 'Search all contracts' to the input props.

title: Split panel left side receives unfiltered contracts prop — attention filtering logic absent
detail: ViewSplitPanel receives props.contracts from the parent, which is pre-filtered by the shared viewMode. But when view C is active, the mode toggle is hidden, so the left panel ('Needs Attention') may show all contracts if viewMode was set to 'all' before switching to view C.
evidence: ContractsList.jsx:176 passes data.contracts. Line 131 hides mode toggle for view C.
recommendedFix: ViewSplitPanel should apply its own attention filter using ATTENTION_STATUSES, independent of the shared viewMode.
